text: その　わざ　ぜひとも　いかして　つよく　なるんじゃ…！

structure.jp: ぜひとも　いかして
structure.en: by all means make good use of it, and

structure.jp: つよく　なるんじゃ…！

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ after a verb can be a firm instruction: 'you are to do this'. んじゃ is the old-man form of んだ. なるんじゃ = 'you must become (strong)'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. いかして = 'make use of it and...'

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く before なる says something becomes that way. つよく　なる = 'become strong'.
